summary: The Green Isle: forested hills and deep bays under a clan hall, with the best timber and the best navigators of the southern isles.

hall_of_verde.name: The Hall of Verde
hall_of_verde.desc: The clan hall is built of green timber and roofed with bark, and a hundred families sit under it at the midwinter feast. Chief Lua Verd sits at the middle bench, not the head.

one_chief_of_verde.name: Chief of All Verde
one_chief_of_verde.desc: The families have named one chief over all, and the hall's great horn is hers to sound. Oaths are renewed at the first frost, and nobody has yet broken one.

forest_law.name: The Forest Law
forest_law.desc: Every tree felled is marked, and two are planted in its place. The woodwards walk the hills with branding-irons and hand-saws, and the forest is the island's bank.

verde_navigators.name: Navigators of Verde
verde_navigators.desc: Verde's navigators learn the southern stars on their fathers' knees, and carry knotted cords to count the nights. They have sailed further than any chart.

navigators_guild.name: The Navigators' Guild
navigators_guild.desc: The guild keeps a hall of star-tables and sea-cords, and a navigator is not called master until he has taught three apprentices. Ships hire them by the season.

focuses.name: The Green Isle
focuses.desc: Verde is the green island of the south, forested to the water's edge and ringed with deep bays. Chief Lua Verd rules among the heads of its families, and sells timber to all who come.

focuses.name: The Hall of Verde
focuses.desc: The families of Verde meet in a long hall of green timber, each beneath its own banner. The hall's roof-beams are carved with the sea-birds of every clan.

focuses.name: Oaths of the Families
focuses.desc: Each family renews its oath to the hall at the first frost, with a handful of earth and a drop of blood. The oath-takers' sons are enrolled in the island's boats.

focuses.name: The Chief's Gifts
focuses.desc: The chief distributes gifts at midwinter: cloth, tools, a boat for a young family. The families repay her in loyalty and in timber.

focuses.name: Chief of All Verde
focuses.desc: The families name one chief over all, and the hall's great horn is hers to sound. Verde has never had a king and does not mean to start now.

focuses.name: The Green Woods
focuses.desc: Verde's great trees grow tall and straight on the windward slopes, and some are older than the first charts. The woodwards mark each one they spare.

focuses.name: Timber for the Yards
focuses.desc: Sawyers cut the planks, and oxen drag them to the shore. The yards of the southern isles buy Verde's timber because it does not rot.

focuses.name: The Great Trees
focuses.desc: Verde's greatest trees become keels, masts and ribs for the finest hulls of the south. A shipwright from the isles will pay a month's wages for a single plank.

focuses.name: Timber for Gala
focuses.desc: Gala's shipwrights send letters asking for straight-grained Verde oak, and a first cargo goes south on a good wind. The elves pay in silver and in courtesy.

focuses.name: Timber for the West
focuses.desc: The West is building a fleet to cross the central sea and has asked the isles for planks. Verde's yards offer five hulls' worth, cut, seasoned and shipped.

focuses.name: The Forest Law
focuses.desc: The woodwards draw up a law of the forest: no tree felled unmarked, none sold unbranded, and two planted for every one cut. The hall signs it with a bark seal.

focuses.name: Navigators of Verde
focuses.desc: Verde's navigators read the southern stars better than any, and the children of the coast learn the star-paths as others learn songs. A good navigator is better paid than a chief.

focuses.name: The Star Paths
focuses.desc: The navigators write their star-paths on knotted cords and plaited palm-leaf, passed from master to apprentice. The paths run to coasts no chart yet shows.

focuses.name: The Long Canoes
focuses.desc: A long canoe of Verde holds forty paddlers and sails like a gull. The island's boatyards turn out a dozen each season.

focuses.name: Guides for Passing Ships
focuses.desc: Ships that call at Verde may hire a navigator to guide them through the shoals. The fee is small, the guides are proud, and the captains remember the courtesy.

focuses.name: A Navigator Sails North
focuses.desc: One of Verde's navigators signs on with a ship bound for Gala, and the island lights a lamp for him on the quay. Verde's name is carried north with the stars.

effects.tooltip: One of our navigators signs on with the King of Gala's ship.

focuses.name: The Navigators' Guild
focuses.desc: The navigators form a guild with a hall, a seal and an oath. Ships from every isle hire its masters by the season.
